Specification: This specification models a simple integer-valued state machine that keeps track of a current value x together with its one-step and two-step history in oldX and olderX. The initial state sets x to a nonnegative integer in a bounded range and initializes the history variables to sentinel values -1 and -2; each transition updates oldX to the previous x and olderX to the previous oldX while choosing a new x from the same bounded range. The file focuses on temporal behavior, specifically checking one liveness property that should hold about eventually seeing 0 in the two-step history after x becomes 0, and a second intentionally false liveness property requiring olderX to eventually become 1 under the same trigger. The comments indicate the purpose is to test behavior of counterexamples with a nonempty non-looping prefix, so the design is intentionally minimal and aimed at model-checking temporal counterexample structure.
